mapper.select:
SELECT c.consult_id AS consultId, c.consult_type AS consultType, c.status AS status,
CASE WHEN c.status = 1 THEN '예약신청' WHEN c.status = 2 THEN '예약확정' WHEN c.status = 3 THEN '상담완료' WHEN c.status = 4 THEN '취소' ELSE '알수없음' END AS statusText,
c.created_date AS createdDate, c.consult_start_date AS consultStartDate, c.consult_end_date AS consultEndDate,
mu.user_name AS memberName, eu.user_name AS expertName,
q.content AS consultContent, a.content AS answerContent,
CASE WHEN a.inquiry_id IS NULL THEN '대기' ELSE '완료' END AS answerStatus,
CASE WHEN a.inquiry_id IS NULL AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, c.created_date, NOW()) > 24 THEN '지연' ELSE '정상' END AS delayStatus
FROM consultation c JOIN user mu ON mu.member_id = c.member_id JOIN user eu ON eu.member_id = c.expert_id
LEFT JOIN inquiry q ON q.inquiry_id = ( SELECT iq.inquiry_id FROM inquiry iq WHERE iq.consult_id = c.consult_id AND iq.comment_type = '질문' ORDER BY iq.write_date DESC, iq.inquiry_id DESC LIMIT 1 )
LEFT JOIN inquiry a ON a.inquiry_id = ( SELECT ia.inquiry_id FROM inquiry ia WHERE ia.consult_id = c.consult_id AND ia.comment_type IN ('전문가답변','관리자답변') ORDER BY ia.write_date DESC, ia.inquiry_id DESC LIMIT 1 )
AND c.consult_type = #{consultType}
AND c.status = #{status}
AND ( CASE WHEN a.inquiry_id IS NULL AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, c.created_date, NOW()) > 24 THEN '지연' ELSE '정상' END ) = #{delayStatus}
AND DATE(c.created_date) >= #{startDate}
AND DATE(c.created_date) <= #{endDate}
AND mu.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND eu.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND ( mu.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR eu.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.consult_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY c.created_date DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consultation WHERE status = 3
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consultation c WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inquiry a WHERE a.consult_id = c.consult_id AND a.comment_type IN ('전문가답변','관리자답변') )

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consultation c WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inquiry a WHERE a.consult_id = c.consult_id AND a.comment_type IN ('전문가답변','관리자답변') ) AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, c.created_date, NOW()) > 24
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consultation WHERE DATE(created_date) = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consultation WHERE status = 3 AND DATE(consult_end_date) = CURDATE()
